user.title: Follow a CBF team
user.description: Choose the season (2026 = 2026/27). Optionally narrow the competitions by name, or paste a phase id / cbf.cz schedule URL (containing p=…) to skip straight to team selection.

data_description.search: E.g. “2.třída” – leave empty to list all.

reconfigure.title: Change followed competition
reconfigure.description: Point this team to another phase, e.g. a new season or the play-off. Entities and their history are kept.

category.title: Category
category.description: Choose the category of the competition.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the CBF server.
error.invalid_data: The CBF server returned unexpected data.
error.no_competitions: No competition with a schedule matches.
error.invalid_phase: Enter a phase id or a URL containing p=<id>.
error.phase_not_found: This phase is not part of the selected season.

abort.already_configured: This team is already followed in this phase.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the CBF server.
abort.invalid_data: The CBF server returned unexpected data.
abort.no_teams: This phase has no teams yet.

data_description.scan_interval_hours: How often to fetch the schedule from CBF (1–24 h). Please keep it gentle on the CBF server.

season_finished.title: {team}: all games played
season_finished.description: All games of {team} in {division} have a result. When a new season or the play-off starts, reconfigure the integration entry to follow the new phase.
